title: .table meta.json
description: A .table's manifest (the bundle's meta.json) or a table's own meta.json (SPEC section 5). Both are optional, and any key not named here is allowed and kept.

format.description: Stamped on every write of the bundle's meta.json.

tables.description: The bundle's tables in the order they are shown. Only in the bundle's meta.json.

iteration.description: A table's own: loops between its formulas worked out by repetition (DECISIONS D60).

source.description: Where this was made from, when it was made from something else: a record of origin that changes nothing about how it's read (SPEC section 5, DECISIONS D66). Every member is optional.

uri.description: An absolute URI: https:, file:, or any other scheme.
